summary: Read fleet membership envelope signers in one joined query instead of one query per claim

replay.detail: No startup or heal replay is added.

schema.detail: No schema, index, trigger or persisted format changes.

rules.detail: The existing membership fold receives the same claim facts and exact envelope signer union, including forks and unsealed local fallback.

compatibility.detail: Client, peer, signature and certificate formats remain unchanged.

downtime.detail: Normal binary restart only; no production latency acceptance is established.

manual.detail: No manual repair or coordinated fleet conversion is required.

recovery.detail: Older binaries read the unchanged store; no migration or new durable state is introduced.
